claims.says: Best June-September (snow-free). Earlier/later seasons may have snow on the couloir and upper reaches.
Late April through June, and conditions-dependent within that window; the couloir must be filled and the snowpack consolidated
The couloir 'melts to loose rock and is generally out of condition' by summer - not recommended
Roughly June through August.

contradictions.why: `season` frames June-September (including July-Sept) as the window, but seasonal_guidance puts the optimal window in spring (Apr-Jun) and explicitly calls July "not recommended" because the couloir melts out; best_season gives a third, different window (Jun-Aug). A climber could plan a July trip believing it's mid-season when the route's own hazard guidance says the couloir is out of condition by then.
